datasets.title: Near-surface air temperature (GEOS-FP)
datasets.desc: Near-surface temperature is calculated by sampling 3-D atmospheric fields from NASA’s GEOS-FP system 3 meters above Earth’s surface. GEOS-FP combines millions of weather observations with a predictive model to create a global best estimate of weather conditions that are used to begin a forecast.

num.what: NASA GEOS-FP 2-metre air temperature (T2M): the mean of the hour ending at the frame's time

datasets.title: Near-surface wind speed (GEOS-FP)
datasets.desc: Near-surface wind speed is calculated by sampling 3-D atmospheric fields from NASA’s GEOS-FP system 10 meters above Earth’s surface. GEOS-FP combines millions of weather observations with a predictive model to create a global best estimate of weather conditions that are used to begin a forecast.

below.text: calm, under about 4 m/s (NASA leaves calm air uncoloured)

num.what: NASA GEOS-FP 10-metre wind speed from U10M and V10M: the mean of the hour starting at the frame's time

datasets.title: Near-surface humidity (GEOS-FP)
datasets.desc: Near-surface Humidity, also known as specific humidity (Q2M) from NASA’s GEOS-FP system. GEOS-FP combines millions of weather observations with a predictive model to create a global best estimate of weather conditions that are used to begin a forecast.

num.what: NASA GEOS-FP 2-metre specific humidity (QV2M): the mean of the hour ending at the frame's time
